versions.unavailable: No stable Marketplace release is compatible with VS Code 1.107.0 on win32-x64

checks: installed npm library symbol shows its source and accepting it inserts the matching import
Prettier formats nested code with three spaces and Auto Save writes the actual file
React rfc/rafce accepted from the real suggestion menu; native Emmet expands div in HTML and TSX
Actual Tab key accepts React snippets and expands Emmet in HTML and TSX
TypeScript reports error 2322 with visible validation decorations and 80% transparent colors
managed extension settings match the installed versions and schemas
automatic import-string suggestion widget opens without Ctrl+Space
npm Intellisense suggests installed packages inside import strings
relative TS and TSX path completion is unique and omits the source extension
HTML and TSX paired tags rename once without competing edits
htmltagwrap wraps the actual selection with matching tags
Turbo Console Log inserts a real log for the selected variable
Oxc lints the installed project while Prettier remains the sole managed formatter
Tailwind offers real class completions and reports invalid directives
CSS validation stays enabled without treating Tailwind directives as unknown rules
English and Russian dictionaries reject misspellings and accept correct words
DotENV language association applies to .env variant files
Material Icon Theme is selected and its registered icon assets exist
Image preview returns an actual local-image hover
Better Comments renders the configured TODO decoration
HTML End Tag Labels renders a real closing-tag label
Highlight Matching Tag renders a real tag underline
Import Cost calculates and renders a real installed package size
Git Branch Panel activates and fetch/push reuse the actual built-in Git API
untested: SQL Server live connection/query requires a user-provided server; its settings are checked separately
Jelly Cursor is optional and has no compatible stable release for this audited IDE engine
